Definition: Jedajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jedaiah = "praised of Jehovah"; 1) a Simeonite, forefather of Ziza; 2) son of Harumaph and one who took part in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
